_comment: Example config for check_fidelity.py, the rerunnable pass/fail fidelity check. Copy this file next to your documents as tali.fidelity.json, edit the values, and run the script with --config pointing at it (or from its directory, where it is found by default). Keys beginning with an underscore are comments and are ignored. All paths are relative to the directory containing this file.
_comment_sources_root: Directory holding the source prose: the version facts change in. Every .md file under it is checked unless 'documents' narrows the set.
_comment_sources_ref: Optional git ref (commit, tag or branch) to read the sources from instead of the working tree, so the check runs against the pinned original rather than whatever happens to be checked out. The config file must sit inside the repository. Delete this key to read sources_root from the working tree.
_comment_voices: Voice key -> where that voice's copies live, mirroring sources_root file for file. A string is a working-tree directory. An object reads the copies from a git ref: {"ref": "voice-casual"} alone reads the same paths as sources_root on that branch or commit (the voice-review branch-per-voice pattern); add "dir" to read a different directory of the repository at that ref, or give "dir" alone for a working-tree directory. A source document with no copy in a voice fails that voice.
_comment_documents: Optional explicit document list, relative to sources_root. Omit to check every .md file.
_comment_skeletons_dir: Optional directory of fact skeletons, read from the working tree: one per source document at the same relative path with .md replaced by .skeleton.md (guides/GETTING_STARTED.md -> skeletons/guides/GETTING_STARTED.skeleton.md). Bullets under the '## Verbatim', '## Labels', '## Fixed phrases' and '## Qualifiers' headings, written as '- Q1: phrase' (surrounding backticks are stripped), become required phrases for that document and report as 'skeleton verbatim', 'skeleton label', 'skeleton fixed phrase' or 'skeleton qualifier'. '## Claims' and '## Distinctions' are left to the verifier. A skeleton phrase the source no longer contains is a config error (exit 2), because the skeleton drifted. A document with no skeleton file is simply not skeleton-checked.
_comment_auto: Items extracted from each source automatically. All on by default: code (fenced blocks verbatim, inline code spans), urls, numbers (digit tokens outside code, ignoring list and heading markers and tokens glued to letters such as Sev-1 or v2). Turn one off only for a document set where it produces noise you have reviewed.
_comment_fidelity: The voice profile's fidelity list, as verbatim phrases. 'all' phrases are required in a voice copy whenever its source contains them. 'documents' phrases are required for that document, and the check refuses to run (exit 2) if the source no longer contains one, because the list has gone stale. Matching ignores whitespace and * emphasis, so rewrapped or bolded text still matches, and looks inside code blocks and inline code as well as prose.

guides/GETTING_STARTED.md: only when the sync service is running

_comment_waivers: Reviewed exceptions. Each needs the exact item and a reason; voice and document are optional and narrow the waiver. Waived items are still printed so the exception stays visible. A waiver without a reason is a config error.

waivers.reason: owner approved 'three' spelled out in the casual voice
